facts.text: All undergraduate students at Milligan complete a core curriculum centered on a Humanities Program that integrates history, literature, philosophy, and fine arts.

sources.title: Core Curriculum - Milligan University
sources.quote: Our unique Humanities Program—incorporating history, literature, philosophy, and fine arts—is central to the Milligan liberal arts education.
